name: The R Villa Tambora
bedroomsText: 3, each with a king-size bed and its own bathroom

facts.text: 3 bedrooms, each with a king-size bed and a bathroom connected to it.
A private garden, a private entrance and outdoor seating.
Air conditioning, WiFi, a TV and a stereo sound system.
Kitchen with stove, microwave, kettle, coffee maker, toaster, blender and a refrigerator with freezer; dining table.
Hair dryer, iron and ironing board; linens, towels and toiletries are provided.
On Jalan Pantai Batu Mejan in Canggu.
